title: Assistant Professor of Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Dr. Peter Grieco completed his undergraduate studies at Boston College, majoring in biology. He received his DDS degree from the Columbia University College of Dental Medicine and then returned to Boston to obtain advanced training in prosthodontics and dental research. He received a certificate in prosthodontics in 2014 and a Doctor of Medical Sciences (DMSc) in 2015 from the Harvard School of Dental Medicine (HSDM). He is currently an instructor in the Department of Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences at HSDM. Grieco's research focuses on dental materials, esthetics, and color science, and he has presented his findings at numerous local, national, and international meetings.
